name: dt_matrix
drl:
rule "focus"
when
    Store()
then
    drools.setFocus("grid");
end
// rule values at A11, header at A6
rule "rule_6_1"
	agenda-group "grid"
	when
		Store(open == true)
		Person(age > 60)
		Membership(tier == "gold")
	then
		insert(new Discount(15));
end

rule "rule_6_2"
	agenda-group "grid"
	when
		Store(open == true)
		Person(age > 60)
		Membership(tier == "silver")
	then
		insert(new Discount(10));
end

rule "rule_7_1"
	agenda-group "grid"
	when
		Store(open == true)
		Person(age > 18)
		Membership(tier == "gold")
	then
		insert(new Discount(5));
end
